title: Paper 2 style section: GlobalHalal plc (25 minutes)
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 49 (Pupil PDF worksheet: own exam-style questions, case data and mark-scheme points (teacher-written))
intro: Lesson 49. Answer every question; self-mark and update your repair list. All businesses, people and figures in these cases are fictional, made up for practice.

passage.title: GlobalHalal plc
paras: GlobalHalal plc makes halal snacks and sells them in 11 countries. It is a public limited company with 2,400 employees. Over the last year it has expanded into three new countries and opened a larger factory in Leicester.

questions.q: Calculate the net profit margin in 2026.
Calculate the percentage fall in unit cost.
Explain one economy of scale GlobalHalal may have gained.
questions.a: Purchasing economies (1): buying ingredients in bulk for 11 countries (1) lowers the unit cost, which fell from £2.40 to £2.10 (1).

questions.q: Analyse the effect of a weaker pound on GlobalHalal's exports.
questions.a: Level-marked (6): exports cheaper abroad, so demand and revenue rise; but imported ingredients cost more, raising costs.

questions.q: Evaluate whether GlobalHalal should keep expanding into new countries.
questions.a: Level-marked (12): revenue +25%, NPM 10% to 12%, economies of scale; vs exchange-rate risk, different tastes and halal rules, managing 2,400 staff in more places.

markScheme.a: Level 3 (5-6): two developed chains of reasoning, both in context. Level 2 (3-4): developed reasoning, partly in context. Level 1 (1-2): points identified with little development. Level 4 (10-12): developed chains on both sides in context and a supported judgement with 'it depends on'. Level 3 (7-9): both sides developed, judgement partly supported. Level 2 (4-6): some development, one-sided or generic. Level 1 (1-3): points identified.
